author: Vox
description:
Only 9% of young adults believe that the government's official explanations for major events are usually accurate, according to a survey by Murmuration. Rachel Janfaza, the founder of Gen Z strategy firm The Up and Up, talks to Vox’s Astead Herndon about why trust is low in this week’s America, Actually.

Listen on Saturday wherever you get your podcasts, or watch here on YouTube.

description:
